description: As the world population grows and climate change intensifies, how can we transform the food supply chain to be more sustainable and resilient? Mike Zelkind , co-founder and CEO of 80 Acres Farms, is building a network of hyper-efficient, high-tech, indoor farms to provide local communities with fresh, nutritious produce. He joins Azeem Azhar to discuss the challenges of disrupting the farming industry to innovate the future of food. They also discuss: Why fruits and vegetables are now bred for l…
classificationReason: Discusses how robotics and AI optimize indoor-farm yield, taste, and growing time.
qualityReason: Original CEO interview with a focused discussion of technology applied to farming.
